items.title: Is Lululemon a warning sign for retail stocks? What investors should know.
items.summary: "The Awesome Portfolio" author Jared Dillian and Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre join Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss Lululemon (LULU) stock tumbling after its Q2 earnings release and the investing strategy for approaching the broader apparel industry.
